property_summary: After correctRState, if the R-state was BELOW_ONE and base reserve < base target, then R-state becomes ONE and both targets equal the current reserves; if R-state was ABOVE_ONE and quote reserve < quote target, same result; otherwise R-state and both targets are unchanged.
